record.t: Was re-elected to the North Carolina House of Representatives in 2020.

record.t: Was elected to the North Carolina House of Representatives in 2018, defeating a four-term incumbent in District 103.
record.q: Rachel Hunt was elected to the North Carolina House of Representatives in 2018, overcoming the odds to defeat a four-term incumbent in the fiercely contested and heavily gerrymandered District 103

record.t: Serves as the 36th Lieutenant Governor of North Carolina.
record.q: As the 36th Lieutenant Governor of North Carolina, Rachel will continue her public service and advocacy on behalf of the state she loves.

record.t: Wrote to Senators Thom Tillis and Ted Budd urging federal-level action on tariffs and trade policy, the War in Iran and costs.
record.q: She also wrote to Senator Thom Tillis and Senator Ted Budd to urge them to work for solutions at the federal level to stabilize tariffs and trade policy, bring an end to the War in Iran and take additional steps to bring costs down.
